name: SKU Source Passport product loop SOP

scope.goal: Turn selected ecommerce SKUs into AI-readable product source packs, human review artifacts, retrieval monitor reports, and revision suggestions.

criteria: Specs are explicit enough to create evidence-backed claims
Buying questions can be expressed without price or inventory
Limitations or compatibility boundaries are explicit

selection_record_template.reason: [why official evidence and buyer questions make this SKU delivery-ready]

reusable_assets.rule: Assets must stay brand-neutral. Real brands belong in customer workspaces or examples only, never in reusable templates.

input_contract.claim_rule: Every ProductClaim must reference at least one Evidence.id.
input_contract.unknown_fact_rule: Omit unknown facts instead of guessing.

commands.command: python -m creator_passport sku-build path\\to\\customer\\sku-source.json --out generated\\customer-sku-source-pack --runs path\\to\\customer\\retrieval-runs.json

commands.pass_condition: Review artifact has no error severity issues. Draft status warnings require human approval before publication.
All required SKU source pack artifacts exist.

commands.command: python -m creator_passport sku-monitor-batch path\\to\\customer\\sku-source.json --out generated\\customer-sku-source-pack --runs path\\to\\customer\\retrieval-runs.json
commands.pass_condition: Each run maps to a known question_id and SKU id, with actionable revision suggestions when retrieval signals are missing or wrong.

review_gates: No demo or placeholder facts in the selected SKU JSON
No price, inventory, discount, rating, review count, or ranking fields in source input
Every generated source page has a canonical URL and source hash
Creator Source Passport workflow tests still pass
verification_commands: python -m unittest tests.test_sku_cli tests.test_sku_render tests.test_sku_monitor tests.test_workflow
